readings.Aries: The shortcut exists. It will cost you something you didn't account for. Worth knowing now. Notice what hasn't changed, not just what has.
readings.Taurus: There's a version of the life you're living that costs you less energy. Locate it. Make contact with the actual person rather than the version in your head.
readings.Gemini: There is a version of the conversation you keep starting that would actually end it. Try that one. The answer that feels too obvious is probably the actual answer.
readings.Cancer: What you call home, others call a refuge. You created that. It required sacrifice. Notice both. Notice what hasn't changed, not just what has.
readings.Leo: The dignity you carry is real and sometimes it makes you harder to reach. Lower the threshold slightly. Sleep on it before committing.
readings.Virgo: You have a high tolerance for imperfection in others and almost none for it in yourself. Recalibrate. Say the thing you've been rehearsing.
readings.Libra: You are allowed to have a preference. Having one does not make you unfair. The resistance you feel is pointing at something worth examining.
readings.Scorpio: Something is moving beneath the surface. You can feel it. Trust the feeling. The connection you almost didn't make is the one that matters.
readings.Sagittarius: The journey you're on has been lonely at points. The loneliness is not a flaw in the journey. The week ahead rewards preparation you can still do today.
readings.Capricorn: Your standards for yourself are borrowed from somewhere. Examine the source. Saying less will move this further than saying more.
readings.Aquarius: Something about the past that you've analysed and filed away is asking to be felt, not just understood. The window for this is shorter than it looks.
readings.Pisces: Something that feels like confusion is actually the process of integrating two incompatible things. Let it process. The resistance you feel is pointing at something worth examining.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
